splits.rule: Common70/15/15 calendar; each full context and target stays inside one contiguous split segment

selection: Lowest VALIDATION loss; TEST not used to choose checkpoints or hyperparameters
limitations: Quantiles are marginal, not joint sampled price paths or calibrated fill probabilities.
Training window sampling is random inside contiguous TRAIN segments; no TEST context or labels enter training.
No historical macro or fundamental inputs are fabricated. Any supplied facts require explicit available_at; source PIT provenance still requires an independent audit.
Reference crypto candles are Binance USDT spot; target Wallex venue and execution costs require separate validation.
Validation/test full contexts are confined to each split, purging shared label and context rows.

promotion.rule: VALIDATION only: >=2% MAE improvement over pretrained AND flat, improved pinball, q10-q90 coverage 70%-90%; advisory only

clock.missing_policy: Native NaN masks on regular clock; no interpolation or zero-filled prices
